author: XBOX
description:
Volatiles is a fast-paced, top-down action roguelike from indie studio Instant Defeat, published by 11 bit studios.

Build your own battlefield to survive an invasion within your mind. Every run starts from a single tile — fight alien hordes, level up, and place new tiles to expand the arena and shape your build. Weapons, upgrades, traps, and risky synergies are all on the table. And when you fall, you wake up in a cold, water-filled tank with new knowledge for next time.

Something buried in your mind is feeding you visions of battles that shouldn't exist. Somewhere outside this nightmare, strangers in a covert lab are watching — and whatever is growing in your head is learning how to take control.

Your mind must become your weapon. Build smart, and you might just get out alive.
